name: t3code
one_liner: A remote control (phone app, desktop app, or web app) for the AI coding assistants already running on your computer, so you can check on or steer a coding task from your phone instead of staying glued to your laptop.
buyer: A developer who kicks off a long AI coding task and wants to check progress or approve a risky step from their phone while away from their desk.
business_use_cases: A freelance developer monitors and approves AI agent actions on a client project from their phone while commuting.
A small dev team uses it to let a non-desk-bound lead approve or redirect in-progress AI coding sessions remotely.
A solo founder babysits an overnight AI build-out from bed via the mobile app instead of leaving a laptop open.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a managed/hosted tier with team seats, shared session history, and permissioning for small dev teams.
Sell integration/setup consulting for teams standardizing on multiple agent harnesses who want one remote control surface.

steal_this: This is a dev-only convenience tool with no end-customer market beyond developers themselves; the realistic weekend move is skipping a new business here and instead just using it to be more productive.
